tests/fixtures/*.json: the OpenAMS mock Moonraker fixtures (OpenAMSOrg/openams, tools/mock_moonraker/fixtures), the public contract examples.

recorded/*.json: OpenAMS host statuses recorded from host runs. recorded/*.dump are their goldens, generated by tests/replay_vams_fixtures.sh with UPDATE=1 and checked by hand; recorded/*.view.json are the view builders' own JSON (src/view/view_json.c) for each fixture, generated by tests/replay_view_goldens.sh with UPDATE=1 and checked by hand against docs/design/UNIFIED_UI.md 4. Refresh a fixture and its goldens together.
